problems.title: Translation of Gamma-weighted trial vectors destroys positivity
problems.claim: For A>-1 and N>(1+A)^−1, the paper's shifted vectors F_j span an M-dimensional positive subspace of H(k;A).
problems.location: Lemma8.4,arXiv pp44–46; specific definitions and calculation p45; accepted p45 identical at this anchor; TeX2739–2797
problems.assumptions: A=-1/4,omega=1,T=2pi,k=-7/2,N=2,j=2; A>-1,N>4/3; trigonometric symbol satisfies smoothness; every real k allowed.
problems.check: With a=Gamma(1/2+3i/2),b=Gamma(1/2+5i/2),gamma1=conj b,gamma2=conj a; DF2=(a/conj b,b/conj a). Cross product=1 exactly. r=|a|²/|b|²=cosh(5pi/2)/cosh(3pi/2)>e^pi/2>4.
problems.counterevidence: Theorem8.4 itself is not refuted. Recomputing weights at shifted positions would repair, but is not printed definition. Disjoint supports do not imply positivity. All parameter assumptions checked; exact sign proof avoids finite-precision uncertainty.
problems.impact: 8.4 supplies infinitude for8.1 and positive/negative lists used8.7/8.6 coexistence. This is a core example derivation. General1.2/1.4 unaffected.
problems.correction: Set Ftilde_j[n]=gamma_n^−1 on each shifted block and zero elsewhere. Finite support avoids any unbounded-inverse use; mixed forms vanish; every diagonal form=(1+A)N−1>0. Arbitrary M gives infinite positive eigenvalues, symmetry gives negative counterpart; semidefinite cases unchanged.
problems.repair_verification: Complete local proof verified; restores full Lemma8.4 and its cited inputs.

checks.source_anchors: Source TeX lines 2691?2925; author v2 and UCL accepted manuscript p.45
checks.reason: The actual definition shifts the entire Gamma-weighted vector f, not only its support. At A=-1/4, omega=1, k=-7/2 and N=2 all stated hypotheses hold, including the unrestricted real-k quantifier. F2 has indices 5,6 with DF2=(a/conj(b),b/conj(a)); its cross term is exactly 1 and its diagonal contribution is -(r+1/r)/4, where r=cosh(5pi/2)/cosh(3pi/2)>exp(pi)/2>4. Thus q(F2)<0 while q(F1)=1/2. The discrepancy is exact, not numerical rounding or an incorrect restriction to a fundamental cell. The source explicitly invokes Lemma 8.4 for infinitude in the flat-band construction and the positive/negative band lists in coexistence.
checks.counterevidence: The general spectral theorems do not depend on this construction. The example refutes the asserted trial-subspace proof, not the lemma's conclusion. Disjoint supports eliminate cross terms but do not ensure positivity of each diagonal form.
checks.repair_check: Recompute gamma_n^{-1} at every actual shifted index. Finite support makes each corrected vector an element of l2 without assuming a bounded inverse to the infinite diagonal D. Tridiagonal off-block couplings vanish, every block form is (A+1)N-1>0, and arbitrary M gives infinitely many positive eigenvalues by min-max. The source's exact A -> -A unitary symmetry gives the negative case, while semidefinite endpoints survive. The report's full local repair and its Major proof-dependency scope are supported.
